scoring_justification: Checker recomputes surface energies from slab_energies.csv and bulk_energy.txt using E_surf = (E_slab - n*E_bulk)/(2A) and compares to paper-reported gold with tolerance; also verifies relative ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference surface energies for B4C orientations and their expected ordering.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: E_cleav (eV/Å²) for six orientations.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded from the published paper values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly the DFT-calculated surface energies reported in the paper's Table 1, traceable.

outputs.description: Specific surface energies for six B4C slab orientations. The checker recomputes surface energies from the agent's intermediate bulk and slab energies and compares to this file.
